process_lessons.lesson: continue-on-error step conclusion can mask underlying outcome; consume the final enforcement and artifact before declaring a gate green.
Deleting filesystem I/O is not equivalent to deleting work; measure phase internals after each intervention.
Never trade away a mutation/correctness boundary for a performance green.
